result.topic_en: Gauss extends the two arithmetic-geometric-mean sequences backwards (to the left) by solving the quadratics xx − 2ax + bb = 0, obtaining doubly infinite series I and II whose common rightward limit is the AGM, and begins showing that series I grows without bound to the left.
